mapper.select: SELECT r.*, o.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userName, u.phone AS userPhone, d.name AS doctorName, i.name AS itemName FROM report_item r LEFT JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN checkitem i ON r.item_id = i.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
